name: researchzy-manuscript
description: Prepare a manuscript with your agent: check that references are real and correct, review statistical reporting, draft Data and Code Availability statements and answer reviewers. No account needed.

interface.shortDescription: Check references and statistics, and answer reviewers.
interface.longDescription: Check that a manuscript's references are real and correct and that cited papers support the text, audit statistical reporting, draft Data and Code Availability statements, and turn reviewer comments into a revision package. Works on the files you give it; no Researchzy account needed.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check the references in this manuscript: are they real, and do the DOIs belong to them?
